$schema: clone-website extraction artifact — consumed by scripts/emit-design-system.ts
name: CIE Validação DNE

extraction.target: https://fesn.appcie.org/<codigo> — DNE credential verification page (FESN-operated, separate domain)
extraction.sourcePath: Angular 16+ SPA; compiled styles.e2bebc4ec5781c7c.css (Angular Material + Bootstrap-derived alert/list-group utilities)
extraction.evidence: This target declares ZERO CSS custom properties on :root — Angular Material compiles its theme into static SCSS output, so there is no authored token layer to read. Every value here was measured with getComputedStyle() in headless Chromium at 1440/768/390 and converted to sRGB through a 1x1 canvas readback. That makes this package a materially weaker evidence base than a token-declaring target: role names are inferred from usage, not from the author's own naming.
extraction.note: Light-only. Only slots with a real or derived value are listed; the emitter fills the rest from OpenDesign fallbacks and B-slot aliases.

--surface.reason: the single content shell that holds the whole document

--surface-warm.reason: the success-alert surface behind the validation chain output

--fg.reason: body ink, labels and values alike — this target uses pure black, not a slate

--fg-2.reason: Angular Material's primary-text alpha, used by the toolbar

--muted.reason: the target has no distinct muted text tier — every text node is #000 or the .87 toolbar alpha. Mapped to the same .87 rather than inventing a grey.

--meta.reason: no tertiary text tier exists on the target; Material's standard secondary-text alpha used as the schema value

--border.reason: the PEM container hairline — the only solid border colour on the page

--border-soft.reason: mat-divider under the header, and the list-group rows use the near-identical .125 alpha

--accent.reason: CIE teal — the ONLY chromatic colour in the interface, used for every section heading (DADOS PESSOAIS, DADOS ESTUDANTIS, DADOS CERTIFICADO DE ATRIBUTO, CERTIFICADO … PEM)

--accent-on.reason: the target never fills a surface with the accent — it is text-only. White is the readable pairing (4.6:1 against #24858d).

--accent-hover.reason: no accent hover state exists on the target; one step darker

--accent-active.reason: no pressed accent state exists on the target

--success.reason: the validation-chain result text inside the success alert

--warn.reason: the page carries an .alert-warning class on the 'Importante' paragraph, but it renders with plain #000 text and no fill — the warning palette is never actually painted. Bootstrap's warning ink recorded as the schema value.

--danger.reason: no error state is reachable on this route — it renders only the success path

--font-display.reason: Angular Material typography applied to every heading. NOTE: like the FESN target, Roboto is declared but never delivered — all @font-face entries report status 'unloaded' and no font file is requested, so it renders as Helvetica Neue / system sans.

--font-body.reason: one family for the whole document, headings and body alike

--font-mono.reason: the PEM certificate block is rendered in proportional Roboto at 12.6px, NOT a monospace face — this slot is unused by the target

--text-sm.reason: the document's base size — body, field labels, field values, alerts, links

--text-base.reason: Angular Material's base; the target renders body copy at 14px and never uses 16px in visible content

--text-xl.reason: mat-toolbar type size in the sticky header

--text-2xl.reason: all three document titles (h1, h2, h3) share one size

--text-3xl.reason: unused by the target — its type ramp stops at 24px. Continues the scale for schema completeness.

--text-4xl.reason: unused by the target — no display tier exists on this page

--section-y-desktop.reason: .texto blocks separate the lower sections with a 30px top pad — the page's only vertical rhythm unit

--section-y-tablet.reason: unchanged at 768 — the layout is byte-identical to 1440 (both 2116px tall)

--section-y-phone.reason: unchanged at 390; the page grows by reflow, not by rhythm changes

--container-max.reason: both the header logo row and the content column cap at 772px

--container-gutter-phone.reason: unchanged at 390 — Material keeps a constant 16px gutter

--space-2.reason: not used directly; fills the gap between the observed 4px and 12px steps

--space-3.reason: alert vertical padding and block margin-bottom

--space-5.reason: alert horizontal padding and photo container padding

--space-6.reason: not used by the target; scale continuation

--space-12.reason: not used by the target; scale continuation

--radius-sm.reason: list-group row corners on the certificate download rows

--radius-pill.reason: no pill geometry exists on the target

--elev-flat.reason: alerts, the PEM box and the list rows are all flat, separated by border or fill

--elev-ring.reason: the target draws hairlines as real borders; expressed as a ring for schema parity

--elev-raised.reason: the content shell's lift — the only shadow on the page

--focus-ring.reason: no custom focus treatment is authored; links fall back to the UA outline. Derived from --accent so the schema slot resolves to something on-brand.

--motion-fast.reason: the page is entirely static — no transition or animation is declared on any element. Angular Material's standard duration recorded.
